{'text': 'Apple Music 正式推出品牌重塑，帶來全新設計、標誌等更新。Apple 在一段詳細介紹品牌重塑的影片中透露，新形象其實是由「聲音打造」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple Music has officially launched its rebrand with a new design, logo, and more. And in a video detailing the rebrand, Apple reveals the new look was actually “made by sound.”'}

{'text': 'Apple Music 正式啟動品牌重塑，公開新標誌幕後製作過程', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple Music officially launches rebrand, publishes behind-the-scenes of new logo'}

{'text': '過去幾星期，我們已見到 Apple Music 即將進行重大品牌重塑的種種跡象，包括在 iOS 27.2 中出現的全新 app 圖示及其他設計更新。', 'paragraph_context': 'We’ve seen signs for weeks that Apple Music had a big rebrand coming, including a fresh app icon and other design updates in iOS 27.2.'}

{'text': '如今 Apple 正式揭曉全新形象，並表示這個形象是由「聲音打造」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Now Apple has officially unveiled its new look and shared that it was “made by sound.”'}

{'text': '來自 X 上的 Apple Music 官方帳戶：', 'paragraph_context': 'From the official Apple Music account on X:'}

{'text': '一如 Apple TV 當年品牌重塑的做法，Apple 發佈了一段幕後製作影片，解釋新標誌是以實物方式製作。對於 Apple 的音樂串流服務而言，這個做法別具意義，新 Apple Music 形象正是「由聲音打造」。Apple 表示：', 'paragraph_context': 'Like it did when Apple TV rebranded, Apple has published a behind-the-scenes video explaining that the new logo was created practically. And in a fitting move for Apple’s music streaming service, the new Apple Music look was “made by sound.” Apple says:'}

{'text': '與 Fred again.. 和 NEST Acoustics 攜手呈現的音樂、協作與工藝故事。了解聲音如何令 Apple Music 標誌活現眼前，全程以鏡頭實景拍攝。讓音樂，化作可見的形態。', 'paragraph_context': 'A story of music, collaboration and craft with Fred again.. and NEST Acoustics. Discover how sound brought the Apple Music logo to life, captured entirely in camera. Just music, made visible.'}

{'text': '最高讚數留言由 Keith B. 發佈', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by Keith B.'}

{'text': '佢哋到底浪費咗幾多時間同錢，淨係為咗喺魚缸度整啲波紋？新 Siri 依然無法喺 Apple Music 播放我「最近加入」嘅播放清單。😒', 'paragraph_context': 'How much time and money did they waste to make waves in a fish tank? Still, new Siri can’t play my Recently Added playlist in Apple Music. 😒'}

{'text': '以下係 Apple Music 品牌重塑嘅幕後製作影片：', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s the behind-the-scenes video of the Apple Music rebrand:'}

{'text': '用戶將可於下星期推出的 iOS 27.2 中，睇到煥然一新嘅 Apple Music 品牌形象。', 'paragraph_context': 'Users will see the refreshed Apple Music identity in iOS 27.2 when it launches next week.'}

{'text': '你點睇 Apple Music 嘅全新形象？歡迎留言告訴我哋。', 'paragraph_context': 'What do you think of Apple Music’s new look? Let us know in the comments.'}

{'text': 'Apple Music 月費為 11.99 美元，亦可透過訂閱 Apple One 組合方案享用。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple Music is available for $11.99/month, or you can get it as part of the Apple One bundle.'}
